name: QYLAT Email - Send worker (claims, sends via Resend, records outcome, alerts Liz)

parameters.content:
## QYLAT Email - Send worker
Claims pending rows from outbound_emails (atomic, skip locked), sends each through Resend with the row id as the idempotency key, records sent, failed or uncertain, and emails Liz about anything that is not sent. Never retries on its own. Requeue by hand with requeue_outbound_email(id).

Sends nothing while outbound_email_settings.send_mode is 'off'. In 'test' only addresses in test_allowlist are sent.

Kick URL: https://n8n.ideatoplan.to/webhook/qylat-email-kick-v1 (N8N_EMAIL_KICK_WEBHOOK_URL in Vercel).
